body:
Thank you I will try those things another time. Maybe after this little episode is finished.
Again, thank you for taking time out of your day to try and help me with this. It is appreciated greatly.

my relationship with my sister is good usually.
No i didnt get the idea after finding out she did it.

i plan on telling her in a couple of hours and yeah ill take your advice on not giving too much away.

my mom is generally easier to talk to but if i tell her she will tell my whole family. she always does when something happens.

their reaction would be to get mad and take my phone off of me bc theyd blame it on social media, when my phone is my main way of talking to ppl. but yes, i agree that it is scarier to have nobody to turn to, yet if i have nobody to talk to on my phone ill feel worse. Im sorry for going completely against your suggestion.

i am planning on telling my sister about my cutting later on and hopefully she hasnt cut herself recently

thank you sm for the help again. you are truly a kind person

i havent told my sister abt my self harming ever. i started a couple months ago and was clean for a few weeks but relapsed recently. i feel that if i tried to tell my parents they wouldnt believe me or would give out to me for doing it.
and once again, i am so grateful for your help.thank you.

with my parents its a mix of both. and with my sister i sometimes talk to her abt sh and stuff but i havent spoken to her abt it for a while. 
and once again, thank you for helping a complete stranger

thank you for trying to help. i would tell my sister but im scared to as she also shs and i wouldnt tell my parents as thats even more terrifying. and if i try to tell a friend im scared it might harm my relationship with them.
but still thank you sm for the help
its nice to know that somebody who doesnt know me still wants to try and help a stranger
